summary: Capital Southwest Corporation filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a Fourth Amended and Restated Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement. The facility commitments increased from $510 million to $595 million, with an accordion feature up to $1 billion. The revolving period extends to September 2030 and final maturity to September 2031. Unused commitment fees reduced to 0.50%-0.75% per annum. ING Capital LLC serves as administrative agent. This is a routine credit facility amendment for a business development company, not a special situation—no change of control, tender, or strategic event is involved. What to watch: covenant amendments imply ongoing capital deployment strategy.
